name: Priestess Anetta
summary: Priestess Anetta is a human cleric of the Holy Light stationed inside Northshire Abbey. As a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire, she instructs newly arrived priests in their first sacred rites.

sections.title: Tender of the Faithful
sections.body: Priestess Anetta can be found on the ground floor of Northshire Abbey within its quiet library wing. Amid the threat of Defias bandits and kobolds troubling the valley, she serves as a grounding presence for the Brotherhood of Northshire, reminding all who pass not to turn their backs on the Light, for it may be the one thing that saves them someday.

sections.title: Guiding Novice Priests
sections.body: Within the cloister, Anetta acts as the primary mentor for budding human priests. Novices who arrive with a hallowed letter of introduction seek her out to learn the fundamentals of faith: channeling holy words to mend flesh and unleashing smiting radiance to repel evil. Under her tutelage, young acolytes prepare to carry the Light beyond Northshire's secluded walls.

faq.answer: Priestess Anetta is a human priest trainer and healer belonging to the Brotherhood of Northshire. She resides on the ground floor of Northshire Abbey in the library wing, where she mentors novice priests.

faq.q: Where can I find Priestess Anetta?
faq.answer: She is located inside Northshire Abbey in northern Elwynn Forest. Enter the front gates of the abbey, proceed into the main hall, and look to the ground floor of the library wing.

faq.q: What role does she play in the Abbey's defense?
faq.answer: While Stormwind marshals and recruits fight to reclaim the valley from Defias bandits and kobolds, Anetta trains the priests among them, teaching them to heal and protect their comrades with the Light.
Anetta teaches entry-level clerical spells and prayers to young priests, instructing them in the fundamentals of healing and smiting enemies in the name of the Holy Light.

angles.text: For young human priests starting in Northshire, Priestess Anetta is your very first mentor, validating your holy calling and teaching you how to commune directly with the Light.
Anetta represents the enduring spiritual core of the Alliance, preparing young priests to support those defending Northshire Valley.
